descriptionChirho: Piel: to scatter or disperse people among the nations as an act of divine judgment or military conquest
Qal: to winnow grain by tossing it into the wind to separate the chaff, an agricultural activity often used as a metaphor for judgment
Metaphorical extension of winnowing: to sift or thoroughly examine someone's ways, as God searches and knows a person (Ps 139:3)
To spread out or scatter things (not people), such as spreading a net or scattering substances; includes participial and general spreading uses
Nifal/Pual passive: to be scattered or dispersed, describing the state of being spread among the nations or cast about
To cast away or fling aside with revulsion, as one discards an unclean thing (Isa 30:22)
